command:
stty -echo
test -t 0 && test -t 1 && test -t 2
printf 'a0-98e7df95-4ad1-4c20-8bee-495f2efa44eb:tty\n'
printf 'a0-98e7df95-4ad1-4c20-8bee-495f2efa44eb:home-list-start\n'
contents=$(ls -A "$HOME")
printf '%s\n' "$contents"
printf 'a0-98e7df95-4ad1-4c20-8bee-495f2efa44eb:home-list-end\n'
test -z "$contents" && test ! -e "$HOME/.omp"
printf 'a0-98e7df95-4ad1-4c20-8bee-495f2efa44eb:empty-home\n'

stty -echo
test -t 0 && test -t 1 && test -t 2
printf 'a0-43cac17b-a97e-4eba-8c82-91b93327ccf0:tty\n'
printf 'a0-43cac17b-a97e-4eba-8c82-91b93327ccf0:home-list-start\n'
contents=$(ls -A "$HOME")
printf '%s\n' "$contents"
printf 'a0-43cac17b-a97e-4eba-8c82-91b93327ccf0:home-list-end\n'
test -z "$contents" && test ! -e "$HOME/.omp"
printf 'a0-43cac17b-a97e-4eba-8c82-91b93327ccf0:empty-home\n'
IFS= read -r PEPGENT_GATEWAY_TOKEN
export PEPGENT_GATEWAY_TOKEN
set +e
bun /tmp/soroi-a0/a0-bootstrap.ts
status=$?
printf 'a0-43cac17b-a97e-4eba-8c82-91b93327ccf0:finished:%s\n' "$status"
IFS= read -r release
exit "$status"
